description: Explains how the traveller can confirm their own phone supports eSIM and is unlocked before buying, with steps for iPhone and Android. Optionally pass the phone brand to get brand-specific steps. Use it before create_checkout_link when the user is unsure their phone will work; an incompatible or locked phone is the most common reason an eSIM cannot be installed.

brand.description: Optional phone brand, e.g. iPhone, Samsung, Google Pixel, Xiaomi

name: check_phone_compatibility
title: Check phone eSIM compatibility
